value_play.leaf_note: ADOPTED 2026-09-26: NO-LEAF escalation with the RELAXED start-gate alpha. This deck ships NO value leaf and this file carries NO eval_model -- `leaf: "none"` makes AttachValueSidecar substitute Constant(), so there is no model to consult. The file exists because sidecar PRESENCE is what activates the shape (and what gates the H-cell ladder), and because mulligan generation reads mull_gen_* from value_play. WHY NO LEAF WAS GENERATED AT ALL: scripts/shape_probe.py (the prescribed cheap early test, run BEFORE any generation) returned leaf "none" on 8 x 500 games at the deck's d5/b20 -- so generating a value leaf for this deck would have spent hours fitting a model the search does not want. EVIDENCE for this adoption, scripts/wk_shape_screen.py, 3 arms x 5 configurations x 8 x 500 games = 72,000 games, paired per game on identical (seed, game index), seeds 5,510,000+: d0b0 BYTE-IDENTICAL 4000/4000 (the control -- depth 0 does no search, so all arms must agree, and they do); d3b10 1 better / 0 worse at 0.86x units; d3b20 0/0 BYTE-IDENTICAL 4000/4000 at 0.89x; d5b20 4/0 z+2.0 at 0.20x; d5b40 4/0 z+2.0 at 0.21x. REPRODUCED on a DISJOINT seed base (7,730,000+), d5b20: 0 better / 0 worse at 0.21x, 3996/4000 digests identical. That is zero worse games in every one of six cells, units never above 0.89x, and a clean reproduction -- a clean win on both axes, which is the pre-approved adoption class. Cost axis is deterministic UNITS (MTG_DUMP_UNITS); wall clock was not separately measured, but a 5x unit reduction is far outside wall's noise.
value_play.ladder_note: REJECTED 2026-09-26: `ladder: "single"` (the FIT single pass) is NOT adopted, and this is the finding that justified running a full screen instead of trusting the probe. scripts/shape_probe.py RECOMMENDED it -- `fit_nl` was its verdict at 0.17x units, z+2.2 -- because the probe measures ONE configuration (d5/b20), where `ladder: single` and `leaf: none` are quality-identical (both 4 better / 0 worse) and single is merely cheaper. The 5-configuration screen shows it REGRESSES at the shallower configs: d3b20 0 better / 7 WORSE, z-2.6, d_avg +0.0018 (vs leaf-only's 0/0 byte-identical there), and d3b10 1/3, z-1.0, d_avg +0.0005. Cheaper on units at every config (0.66x d3b10, 0.69x d3b20, 0.16x d5) but paying real quality at d3 -- i.e. a TRADE, not a clean win, so it is the user's call and not an agent's. d3 is not hypothetical: it is where mulligan generation and the suite's d3 tiers live. This is the repo's own 'never classify a bundle by its cleanest part' rule landing on a live case: the probe's `fit_nl` BUNDLES leaf:none with ladder:single, and all of the quality benefit belongs to the leaf half.
